segments.text: Endiman, annig ishki jolashaman, chungi IT House buni kefalatini bergan.
Khazir sizke zor nasi korsitaman Headhunter Vakansalar saytidan
interior designerlar uchun kampanyalar 400 dolardan 1200 dolargachi toleshke tayyar.
Bugun kaskinisi siz 6 aychidi orgen sengiz boladi
va 3 ay depolamalyat va 100 fois ishki jolashizi kefalatini biz beramiz.
Shuh hafta interior design boycha mutlaka depolachiqu darsi boli batadi.
